kpkg.r: Create R Packages with Personal Conventions

Source: R/kpkg.r-package.R
kpkg.r-package.Rd

A personal companion to 'usethis': create R packages with a predefined author, license, tests and documentation setup, and add versioned continuous integration templates for 'GitHub Actions' and 'GitLab CI' (package check and 'pkgdown' site with a released and a development version).
